item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q016_pdb_1acc_domain_split","answer":"SCOP 1.75 treated 1acc chain A as one unbounded domain, d1acca_ (SUNID 43828), in family/superfamily/fold f.11.1.1/f.11.1/f.11, “Anthrax protective antigen,” within class f. By SCOPe 2.08 it had been split at residue 225/226 into two domains: d1acca2 (SUNID 238522; A:14–225), an all-beta PA14 domain in family b.179.1.1, superfamily b.179.1, fold b.179, class b; and d1acca1 (SUNID 238521; A:226–735), in the anthrax-protective-antigen C-terminal-like family f.60.1.1, superfamily f.60.1, fold f.60, class f. Thus the old whole-chain f.11 assignment was replaced rather than inherited uniformly by both pieces. The split shows that a single functional polypeptide can be assembled from independently evolving modules with different structural lineages; co-occurrence in one toxin does not make the modules homologous. Homology searches should therefore query and assess A:14–225 and A:226–735 separately, require region-level sequence or structural alignment with appropriate coverage, and select templates/representatives per domain. A hit to the PA14-like N-terminal region must not classify the C-terminal region or justify transfer of whole-protein anthrax-toxin function, and the converse is also unsafe. Family or superfamily agreement supports evolutionary relatedness only for the aligned module; fold-level similarity alone would not establish homology, while whole-chain searches can miss partial homologs or create misleading composite matches.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_service_info — /api/v1/; /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope__get_scop_pdb_entry — /api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1acc; /api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1acc/chains; /api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1acc/domains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1acc; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1acc/chains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1acc/domains","mcp__scope__get_scop_domains — /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_; /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/parents; /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/homology"]}]}
